module: Career tutorial step 1 ("enterVehicle"): the player gets into the tutorial vehicle, learns the basic controls (accelerate, brake, steer, objectives validated at 0.75 / 0.75 / 0.5 of the input value), chooses their gearbox mode via a driving aids popup, then step 02moveOff is activated. Works in phases: waitVehicleSetup, getInCar, waitBasicControlsPopup, controls, shiftMode, waitBeginFirstChallenge. Extension loaded by gameplay_tutorial_runtime (prefix career_modules_tutorial_step).
notes: The hooks setup, cleanup, onUpdate, onCareerTutorialLeftBounds and onDebugMenu are called by the tutorial runtime; onIntroPopupCareerClosed and onShiftModeSelectedViaPopup are emitted by the popups / the UI (GearboxSelect.vue).
Out-of-bounds events: the first uses an instant reset at the start, the following ones a reset with fade.

setup.desc: Called when the step is activated: resets the objectives, enters the waitVehicleSetup phase, installs the out-of-bounds handler (return to the parking start), activates the evalZone zone, damage tracking, the tutorial's recovery settings and displays the tasks app.

stepData.desc: Step data provided by the runtime (unused).

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Hook emitted when the player leaves the allowed zone: instant position reset only once at the start, then the step's standard reset.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame during the step. Handles the phases: launches the introduction popups, detects that the player got in (gameplay_walk), then validates the throttle/brake/steer objectives and opens the driving aids popup.

cleanup.desc: Called at the end of the step or the tutorial: removes the out-of-bounds handler and the marker above the vehicle.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Hook emitted when an intro popup closes. Depending on the id: v2/approachVehicle displays the "get in the car" objective and a marker; v2/basicControls enables input tracking and starts the engine; v2/beginFirstChallenge activates step 02moveOff.

onShiftModeSelectedViaPopup.desc: Called from GearboxSelect.vue when the player confirms the gearbox mode (shiftMode phase): applies setGearboxMode on the vehicle then displays the beginFirstChallenge popup.

data.desc: Table with the mode field (chosen gearbox mode).

onDebugMenu.desc: Adds a "Skip Step 1" button to the debug menu (puts the player in the driver's seat, starts the engine, moves to the next step).
